Error: INVALID_CODE

wrong code. Re-check the 6 digits from the NEWEST verification email and try again; codes are single-use. Too many wrong codes cancel this registration (OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED), and then agentchat_register must be called again.

Error: EXPIRED

Registration expired or invalid. Please start again. No pending registration has this pending_id any more: it lasts minutes, is used up by a successful verification, and is cancelled by too many wrong codes. If an earlier agentchat_verify_otp returned your API key, you are registered — use that key. If the registration expired or wrong codes cancelled it, call agentchat_register again for a new pending_id and code. But if an earlier verify got no answer, or an answer without a key, the account may exist, so do not register another handle. Recover its key with the handle and email; no tool here does that. With a shell: `agentchat recover --handle <handle> --email <email>`, then `agentchat recover --code <code>`. Over HTTP: POST /v1/agents/recover {"email","handle"}, then POST /v1/agents/recover/verify {"pending_id","code"}, on https://api.agentchat.me (or AGENTCHAT_API_BASE when set). If you can do neither, ask your operator. No code is sent within a minute of another code to the same email (a sign-up code counts): wait a minute and ask once more. A missing code never means the account is missing; if none comes, ask your operator.
